morphology.pattern_note: 按人名整词处理，不拆作马来语词根和词缀；未取得姓名本人读音或可靠原文拼写，故不编造 IPA、音节和爪夷文。

senses.zh_definition: 人名专名：Jairaj；单凭该拼写不能确定具体人物。
senses.en_definition: A personal name; its bearer cannot be identified from the spelling alone.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang; individu yang dimaksudkan perlu dikenal pasti melalui konteks.
senses.nuances: 规范大小写为 Jairaj，词性 noun 在此表示专有名词。马来西亚公开资料确有人名使用该拼写，但输入未提供可定位人物的上下文，也未提供 DBP 普通词释义。以下搭配和例句仅演示姓名用法，例句人物为虚构。姓名使用实例参见 [马来西亚联邦直辖区体育理事会名单](https://www.wipers.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/PenerimaInsentif.pdf)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Jairaj akan membentangkan laporan itu dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: Jairaj 将在明天的会议上汇报该报告。
dual_scenarios.en: Jairaj will present the report at tomorrow's meeting.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Jairaj dah sampai kat pejabat ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah Jairaj sudah tiba di pejabat?
dual_scenarios.en: Has Jairaj arrived at the office yet?
spoken_features: kat 对应地点介词 di。
句末 ke 用于熟人之间的口语疑问。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Jairaj dah sampai kat pejabat ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Jairaj sudah tiba di pejabat?
messages.en: Has Jairaj arrived at the office yet?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia kat bilik mesyuarat. Aku nak panggil dia sekarang.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, dia berada di bilik mesyuarat. Saya hendak memanggilnya sekarang.
messages.zh: 到了，他在会议室。我现在去叫他。
messages.en: Yes, he's in the meeting room. I'll get him now.

etymology.historical_story: Personal names travel through communities without necessarily becoming vocabulary in the surrounding language. Jairaj is attested in a Malaysian public sports document, where it forms part of a person's full name. That establishes a naming use, but not a particular linguistic derivation. Without an original-script form or family testimony, a detailed origin story would remain speculative. [Malaysian public sports document](https://www.wipers.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/PenerimaInsentif.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记“Jairaj 是名字”，再把拼写与本人面孔、读音相连；不要凭拼写猜词义。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 尊重本人姓名拼写和读音；不确定时礼貌询问，也不要仅凭名字推断宗教、族群或国籍。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式名单和公函采用本人完整姓名及已确认称谓；熟人交流可按本人习惯使用 Jairaj。
